lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots arranged in vertical columns posterior to the pectoral fin, with approximately 3 to 5 primary centroids visible per vertical band.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated intensity align with the centroids of the circular blobs, creating a distinct node-based grid across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible along the mid-to-upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with highlights on the superior edge and shadows on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a dense, stochastic distribution of small-diameter high-luminance spots that differ in spatial frequency and size from the structured grid of the lateral flank.
